"""Join existing short-duration references; do not rerun mechanics or adopt CD."""

import hashlib
import json
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
BASE = ('docs/wood-joints-mvp/hypotheses/hl35-candidate/thin-frame-comparison/'
        'eoere-successor-v1/selected-hardware-v1/current-response-v1/')
DURATION = 'docs/bolted-frame-development/load-duration-assessment-v1.json'
HAND = ('fea/generated/selected-hardware-followup-v1/engineering-closure-v1/'
        'panel-corner-handcheck-v1/attempt02.json')
INDEX = 'docs/bolted-frame-development/development-revisions.json'
PINS = {
    INDEX: '6375178044ef78fe9027dcceb4a439489af93582bdf1c9b9ec8d4e019e0df251',
    BASE+'result.json': 'a893860fcd9e3a2d8f54bfe8cac3f4ed92a012ca69c3881784e56df4c420a32e',
    BASE+'components.json': '20de966cb0c684c6d9ebed1cd380999386fa61b12106f9d7b5640e539439efaf',
    BASE+'panel-size-correction.json': 'f17ef1a7f26a779be4e4afce87bfff1025ce86c5af0def97edfd4e87bf597a64',
    DURATION: '96b695b464753489d41662ae96b0aea09330b5bb797df56345d7552fefd0774b',
    HAND: 'dcb35736def8dfbec4da50af3c015173730fa059a749f5a4dea157f7a995d958',
}
CD = 1.6


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def run():
    authenticated = {}

    def read(name, expected):
        path = ROOT/name
        name = str(path.resolve().relative_to(ROOT))
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == expected, f'Source changed: {name}')
        require(authenticated.get(name, expected) == expected, 'Conflicting source pin')
        authenticated[name] = expected
        return raw

    roots = {name: json.loads(read(name, sha)) for name, sha in PINS.items()}
    index, source, correction = roots[INDEX], roots[BASE+'components.json'], roots[BASE+'panel-size-correction.json']
    duration, hand = roots[DURATION], roots[HAND]
    for report in (correction, duration, hand):
        for name, sha in report['source_sha256'].items():
            read(name, sha)
    require(index['geometry']['revision'] == 'eoere-narrow-channel-openings-v1', 'Wrong target')
    require(all(index[key] is None for key in ('current_response', 'structural_assessment', 'engineering_assessment')), 'Current authority changed')
    predecessor = index['preceding_revision']['preceding_revision']
    require(predecessor['current_response']['components']['sha256'] == PINS[BASE+'components.json'], 'Wrong saved response')
    require(source['geometry_revision'] == 'eoere-raised-kicker-screws-v1', 'Wrong saved geometry')
    require(source['hardware_revision'] == 'eoere-selected-purchase-hardware-v1', 'Wrong saved hardware')
    corrections = {(r['case_id'], r['state_id'], r['panel'], r['component']): r
                   for r in correction['affected_bending_rows']}
    require(len(corrections) == 12, 'Missing or duplicate panel corrections')
    rows = {'panel_bending': [], 'panel_rolling_shear': [], 'generic_head': [],
            'generic_withdrawal_gross_thread_proxy': [], 'saved_rear_foot': []}
    used = set()
    for case in source['cases']:
        case_id, state = case['case_id'], case['state_id']
        raw = json.loads(read(case['raw_components']['path'], case['raw_components']['sha256']))
        require((raw['case_id'], raw['state_id']) == (case_id, state), 'Foreign raw state')
        screws = raw['component_reductions']['simultaneous_Hillman_actions_and_generic_references']
        scalars = {r['axis_id']: r for r in case['coarse']['generic_screw_references']['all_screw_reference_scalars']}
        require(len(screws) == len(scalars) == len({r['axis_id'] for r in screws}) == 66, 'Screw census changed')
        for r in screws:
            require((r['case_id'], r['state_id']) == (case_id, state), 'Foreign screw state')
            saved = scalars[r['axis_id']]
            for key in ('generic_head_ratio_CD1', 'generic_withdrawal_required_effective_thread_mm_CD1', 'gross_nominal_length_after_panel_mm'):
                require(r[key] == saved[key], 'Raw/summary screw mismatch')
            head = r['generic_head_ratio_conditional_CD1p6']
            thread = r['generic_withdrawal_required_effective_thread_mm_conditional_CD1p6']
            require(math.isclose(head*CD, r['generic_head_ratio_CD1'], rel_tol=1e-13), 'Head duration applied twice')
            require(math.isclose(thread*CD, r['generic_withdrawal_required_effective_thread_mm_CD1'], rel_tol=1e-13), 'Thread duration applied twice')
            common = {'case_id': case_id, 'state_id': state, 'axis_id': r['axis_id'],
                      'panel': r['panel'], 'receiver': r['receiver']}
            rows['generic_head'].append({**common, 'normal_ratio_bounds': [r['generic_head_ratio_CD1']]*2,
                'short_ratio_bounds': [head]*2, 'demand_N': r['withdrawal_n'],
                'conditional_reference_N': r['generic_head_reference_n_CD1']*CD,
                'simultaneous_lateral_N': r['lateral_n']})
            gross = r['gross_nominal_length_after_panel_mm']
            require(gross > 0, 'Invalid gross penetration')
            rows['generic_withdrawal_gross_thread_proxy'].append({**common,
                'normal_ratio_bounds': [r['generic_withdrawal_required_effective_thread_mm_CD1']/gross]*2,
                'short_ratio_bounds': [thread/gross]*2,
                'required_effective_thread_mm': thread, 'assumed_effective_thread_upper_mm': gross,
                'simultaneous_lateral_N': r['lateral_n']})
        for panel in case['coarse']['panels']['per_panel']:
            for name, r in panel['section_components'].items():
                require(name in ('bending_x', 'bending_y', 'rolling_x', 'rolling_y'), 'Unknown panel mode')
                require(math.isclose(r['sampled_ratio_conditional_CD1p6']*CD, r['sampled_ratio_CD1'], rel_tol=1e-13), 'Panel duration applied twice')
                key = (case_id, state, panel['panel'], name)
                fix = corrections.get(key)
                if fix:
                    require(fix['peak_abs_resultant'] == r['peak_abs_resultant'], 'Foreign panel witness')
                    require(fix['base_reference_per_mm_width_CD1'] == r['reference_per_mm_width_CD1'], 'Foreign panel reference')
                    normal = fix['adjusted_ratio_bounds_CD1']
                    refs = fix['adjusted_reference_bounds_per_mm_width_CD1']
                    short = [v/CD for v in normal]
                    used.add(key)
                else:
                    normal = [r['sampled_ratio_CD1']]*2
                    short = [r['sampled_ratio_conditional_CD1p6']]*2
                    refs = [r['reference_per_mm_width_CD1']]*2
                mode = 'panel_bending' if name.startswith('bending') else 'panel_rolling_shear'
                rows[mode].append({'case_id': case_id, 'state_id': state,
                    'panel': panel['panel'], 'component': name, 'xy_mm': r['xy_mm'],
                    'normal_ratio_bounds': normal, 'short_ratio_bounds': short,
                    'demand_per_mm': r['peak_abs_resultant'],
                    'conditional_reference_bounds_per_mm': [v*CD for v in refs],
                    'Cs_bounds': fix['Cs_bounds'] if fix else [1., 1.]})
    require(used == set(corrections), 'Unused correction')
    for row in duration['saved_rear_foot_comparisons']:
        require(any((c['case_id'], c['state_id']) == (row['case'], row['state_id']) for c in source['cases']), 'Foreign foot state')
        rows['saved_rear_foot'].append({'case_id': row['case'], 'state_id': row['state_id'],
            'receiver': row['receiver'], 'demand_N': row['demand_upper_N'],
            'conditional_reference_N': row['normal_duration_reference_lower_N']*CD,
            'normal_ratio_bounds': [row['demand_upper_N']/row['normal_duration_reference_lower_N']]*2,
            'short_ratio_bounds': [row['demand_upper_N']/(row['normal_duration_reference_lower_N']*CD)]*2})
    require([len(v) for v in rows.values()] == [72, 72, 396, 396, 12], 'Changed reference census')
    summary = {}
    remaining = []
    for mode, values in rows.items():
        peak = max(values, key=lambda r: r['short_ratio_bounds'][1])
        summary[mode] = {'rows': len(values),
            'normal_exceedances': sum(r['normal_ratio_bounds'][0] > 1 for r in values),
            'short_definite_exceedances': sum(r['short_ratio_bounds'][0] > 1 for r in values),
            'short_possible_exceedances': sum(r['short_ratio_bounds'][1] > 1 for r in values),
            'normal_maximum_upper': max(r['normal_ratio_bounds'][1] for r in values),
            'short_maximum_upper': peak['short_ratio_bounds'][1], 'governing': peak}
        remaining.extend({'mode': mode, **r} for r in values if r['short_ratio_bounds'][1] > 1)
    # The completed normal-only statics examples bound concentration, not capacity.
    head_peak = summary['generic_head']['governing']
    transfer = {'same_saved_panel_case': hand['case'], 'panel': hand['panel'],
        'head_tension_target_N': head_peak['conditional_reference_N'],
        'saved_governing_tension_N': head_peak['demand_N'],
        'required_reduction_at_that_axis_fraction': 1-1/head_peak['short_ratio_bounds'][1],
        'three_nearby_ties_peak_normal_N': max(hand['three_nearby_ties_normal_only']['tensions_N'].values()),
        'all_twelve_ties_minimax_normal_N': hand['all_ties_normal_statics_only']['equal_tie_N'],
        'compatible_redistribution_or_full_panel_capacity_established': False}
    for name, sha in list(authenticated.items()):
        read(name, sha)
    own = Path(__file__).read_text()
    return {'schema': 'eoere_saved_action_short_term_disposition/v1',
        'current_geometry': index['geometry']['revision'],
        'saved_action_geometry': source['geometry_revision'],
        'saved_hardware': source['hardware_revision'], 'conditional_CD': CD, 'selected_CD': None,
        'load_basis': 'Retained 250 lb x2 downward + signed 300 N horizontal + 100 mm hold standoff; six saved cases.',
        'summary': summary, 'remaining_short_reference_witnesses': remaining,
        'panel_normal_transfer_target': transfer,
        'current_geometry_foot_bounds_reused': duration['current_geometry_combination_bounds'],
        'source_sha256': PINS, 'authenticated_source_count': len(authenticated),
        'source_closures_reused': [BASE+'panel-size-correction.json', DURATION, HAND],
        'producer_sha256': hashlib.sha256(own.encode()).hexdigest(), 'reproduction_python_source': own,
        'all_sources_unchanged': True, 'frame_or_native_solve': False,
        'geometry_hardware_or_criteria_changed': False, 'structural_acceptance': False,
        'any_hold_cleared': False, 'actual_observations': None,
        'limits': [
            'Single-event strength sensitivity only; no wear/fatigue/lifetime prediction or adopted duration classification.',
            'All source actions are predecessor-model results, not revised-frame force uppers or measured catch histories.',
            'Apply conditional 1.6 once to eligible strength references only; no force reduction, metal, E/Emin, deformation bearing or notch-permission credit.',
            'The withdrawal proxy favorably treats all gross penetration as effective thread; it supplies no Hillman product, steel, splitting or combined lateral capacity.',
            'Panel rows retain sampled plate-method, hold-footprint, Cs interval and local/net-section limits; head references remain generic plywood pull-through.',
            'Failed reference comparisons are not measured breaking loads; below-reference component ratios are not complete-joint passes.',
            'Current foot sufficient uppers above one are inconclusive, not achieved failures.',
            'Normal-only alternative allocations establish equilibrium examples; compatible deformations, pressures, simultaneous shear and frame return remain unqualified.',
            'Plywood cleat joint/leaf-sharing work retains separate ownership; no proposal is adopted here.']}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    result = run()
    with Path(sys.argv[1]).open('x') as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({k: {a: b for a, b in v.items() if a != 'governing'}
                      for k, v in result['summary'].items()}, indent=2))
